item.title: Irong-irong 6
item.description: USA) Publications is the Official Student Press Corps of the University of San Agustin, Iloilo City, Philippines. The corps publishes The Augustinian Mirror (magazine), The Augustinian (newspaper), Irong-irong (literary journal), and Dingding ni Gusting (wall newspaper). This is the official website of the corps that publishes breaking news in and out of the University.
